passages.title: Text 09
passages.text: Dear Susi, The music class is on Monday at 4 p.m. — Mr Dan

passages.title: Text 10
passages.text: At the park, Dodi plays football. His sister reads a book.

passages.title: Text 11
passages.text: Mira has two pets: a white cat and a brown dog.

passages.title: Text 12
passages.text: Hello, Edo. I put your blue shoes next to the front door. Your black shoes are in your room. — Mom

passages.title: Text 13
passages.text: Our class has art on Wednesday and sports on Friday.

passages.title: Text 14
passages.text: Shop sign: Apples are 5,000 rupiah each. Bananas are 3,000 rupiah each.

passages.title: Text 15
passages.text: Lina is at the library. She borrows a storybook, but her brother buys a pencil at the shop.

passages.title: Text 16
passages.text: School note: On Tuesday, Grade 3 meets in Room 2. On Wednesday, Grade 3 meets in Room 5.

passages.title: Text 17
passages.text: Hi Sari, I can play after lunch, but I must help Dad in the morning. Come to my house at 2 p.m. — Wina

passages.title: Text 18
passages.text: Library sign: The reading room is open today. The computer room is closed today. You can read books, but you cannot use the computers.

passages.title: Text 19
passages.text: Trip note: Group A takes the red bus at 8 a.m. Group B takes the blue bus at 9 a.m.

passages.title: Text 20
passages.text: Hi Fikri, Your English book is in my bag. I will bring it to school on Thursday. Please meet me near the school gate after class. — Danu
